fit: aqueous oral Sichuan pepper preparation in MPTP mouse model
assessment: Example 1 reports shorter pole-task times at three decoction levels. Exposure began before model induction. This offers a species-specific motor proxy with no toasted culinary exposure or clinical bradykinesia comparison.

fit: dried Perilla leaves processed into aqueous extract and used in an ocular accommodation trial
assessment: Binocular near-point distances changed from 7.96 to 7.27 cm versus 9.00 to 9.67 with placebo. The article inconsistently reports sample size and has no Parkinson fatigue measure. NCT02641470 identifies another plant study.

fit: celery leaf and stalk decoction in two uncontrolled gout cases
assessment: Both recorded pain scores moved from 5 to 2. The collection dates and intended regimen do not establish follow-up timing. Differences in setting and overlapping outcomes with a later report leave independence unresolved.

fit: celery leaf decoction in uncontrolled gout care
assessment: The abstract reports two cases and a score of 5 to 3. The original body specifies one patient and 5 to 2. Boiled preparation, concurrent advice and no control limit causal attribution.

fit: aqueous freeze-dried cilantro leaf and stalk extract in developmental toxicant model
assessment: Toxin plus extract offspring covered 20.47 m versus 14.35 m with toxin alone. Spontaneous open-field distance is not measured walking velocity. Exposure was maternal.

fit: avocado-oil mayonnaise in a ketogenic sample menu and narrative executive change
assessment: One Down syndrome and Alzheimer case describes executive change during a mixed diet without an isolated oil comparison, oil processing or quantified executive outcome.

fit: whole-fruit mixed menu and unreported executive outcomes
assessment: The same trial registration and publication planned or collected executive tasks. The article and supplement give no result for cognition, and the exposure is whole avocado plus mango.

fit: whole avocado and executive-task MRI and NIH Toolbox registration
assessment: No posted results in available official update, which shows Unknown status. The trial excludes Parkinson disease and assigns fruit rather than oil.

fit: whole avocado crossover with prespecified cognitive measures
assessment: Secondary CANTAB and flanker outcomes are registered without results. The study assigns whole fruit in prediabetes.

fit: pooled omega-3 supplementation and cognitive trajectories by matched observational groups
assessment: MMSE, ADAS-Cog13 and CDR-SB had faster decline in pooled supplement users. No separate flaxseed oil estimate or processing specification. Observational confounding and whole-scale outcomes limit transfer.

fit: flaxseed oil compared with corn oil and registered executive composite
assessment: The mild cognitive impairment pilot defines a composite using Trail Making, digit span and category fluency. No posted results, pressing method or Parkinson intervention.

fit: spinach listed in a mixed Parkinson diet and total motor score
assessment: The menu lists spinach but gives no individual intake or cooked preparation. Total UPDRS III includes facial expression, while no separately reported item or isolated spinach result is available.

fit: mixed oral formula with unresolved perilla and prospective fatigue items
assessment: Registry says 10 g/day and includes perilla. The linked protocol says 30 g/day and omits perilla from Table 1. Termination and absent results leave fatigue effects and actual formulation unresolved.
